This plot is small, only a quarter of a *timad*, but it is close to my house and I planted my enset and some coffee and fruit trees there many years ago. I cannot afford chemical fertilizer for the trees — I save what little money I have for the maize plot. Instead I carry manure from my cattle and kitchen ash to the trees, and my wife and children help me weed and harvest. The rains here in SNNP are enough, so I do not irrigate, and for perennials like enset I use the suckers from my own plants, not bought seed.
